create.name: Esalen Institute
create.bio:
Esalen Institute is a non-profit retreat and learning centre on the Big Sur coast of California, on a grassy headland above the Pacific where natural hot springs feed open-air baths. Two Stanford graduates, Michael Murphy and Richard Price, started it in 1962, taking their cue from the thinking of Aldous Huxley and Abraham Maslow on unused human capacities. Through the 1960s and 1970s it became the chief gathering place of the human potential movement, and people such as Fritz Perls, Alan Watts, Gregory Bateson and Stanislav Grof taught there. The land was home to the Esselen people for thousands of years, and Esalen now looks after it together with the Esselen Tribe of Monterey County.

Most visitors book a residential workshop of a weekend or five days, on anything from meditation, yoga and movement to writing, relationships and psychology, with lodging, meals and the baths included in one price. Self-Guided Explorations offers an open stay with drop-in classes led by resident teachers instead of a set course. The institute also runs its own massage school, teaching the Esalen Massage style that grew up there in the 1960s, a three-month Work Scholar residency, and a think tank, the Center for Theory & Research. Its free Voices of Esalen podcast mixes new interviews with recordings from the archive.

courses.title: Esalen Workshops
courses.description: Esalen's year-round calendar of residential workshops in Big Sur, mostly weekends or five-day weeks, led by visiting and resident faculty across meditation, movement, the arts, relationships, psychology and more. Prices are all-inclusive and depend on the room chosen, from a sleeping-bag space to a private room.

courses.title: Self-Guided Explorations
courses.description: A personal retreat at Esalen without a set workshop. Guests join opening and closing circles with their group and choose freely from open classes in yoga, breathwork, meditation, dance and the arts, or simply rest and use the baths. Massage and other sessions cost extra.

courses.title: Esalen Massage School
courses.description: Training in the Esalen Massage method, which pairs touch with mindful attention, from introductory weekends to practitioner courses at three levels of 175, 250 and 500 hours. Certified teachers also run approved courses away from Big Sur.

courses.title: Work Scholar Program
courses.description: A three-month live-in service residency. Work scholars spend most of the week in the kitchen or housekeeping teams, with time on the farm and garden, alongside a curriculum on presence, meditation and embodied inquiry led by Esalen faculty.

courses.title: Self-Guided Explorations: Week of November 9–13, 2026
courses.description: A five-day open stay run by Esalen's resident teachers: welcome and closing circles, then drop-in classes in yoga, meditation, movement and creative practice, with the baths and grounds to enjoy at one's own pace.

courses.title: Self-Guided Explorations: Week of November 23–27, 2026
courses.description: Thanksgiving week at Esalen as a self-paced retreat: a cohort that opens and closes together, open classes led by resident faculty, and plenty of unscheduled time on the coast.

courses.title: Self-Guided Explorations: Week of December 14–18, 2026
courses.description: A December week of unstructured retreat in Big Sur, with optional daily classes from the resident teaching team in movement, meditation, writing and the arts, framed by group circles.

courses.title: Self-Guided Explorations: Week of January 4–8, 2027
courses.description: A new-year week of self-directed retreat at Esalen. Guests set their own rhythm, drawing on open classes led by resident faculty, the hot springs baths and the cliff-top grounds.

free_resources.title: Voices of Esalen
free_resources.description: Esalen's free podcast, hosted by Sam Stern: interviews with authors, scientists and teachers on the human potential movement, alongside restored archive talks recorded at Esalen since the 1960s.

free_resources.title: Esalen on YouTube
free_resources.description: Several hundred free videos from Esalen: talks by faculty, archive footage, short films about the campus and recordings of public events.

free_resources.title: CTR Journal
free_resources.description: Free online journal of Esalen's Center for Theory & Research, with themed volumes on subjects such as somatics, political polarisation and conscious business.
